EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7 The Land acquisition for construction of Reservoir, Dam, Site Premises, Quarry of Hydro power project of Moraspolla, Gampola.

I, hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the land Acquisition Act, as Amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the following land/servitude* which is required for a public purpose:-

Description of the land or servitude to be acquired: The land allotment called Weliganga Mahawila watta in Total Extent of about 8.1109 Hectares & 1.5735 Hectares depicted and Prepared by Surveyor General in CM No. 320042 (2) 10 & 320042 (1) 4 as shown as lot No. 270-347, 184-200 in Grama Niladari Divisions of Galatha and Weliganga in Kandukara Ihala Korale of Divisional Secretary Division of Udapalatha in Kandy District, Central Province.
